structure.overview: The case concerns a family of five seeking asylum in Canada, with the principal applicant fearing death due to religious conversion and an associated applicant alleging gender-based discrimination in Morocco. The Refugee Protection Division (RPD) initially refused their refugee claim, and the Refugee Appeal Division (RAD) dismissed their appeal. The applicants challenged these decisions, but the appeal was ultimately dismissed.
